column1: # The removed-files index: files taken out of the tree on purpose, so a reader can find them in git.
# One row per file: the path it had, the date it was removed (UTC), the last commit that held it
# (read it back with `git show <sha>:<path>`), and the reason. A row names a path that is absent
# and a sha that exists; helpers/removed_index.py checks both in script/lint. A removed roadmap
# block keeps its number retired: the same script refuses a new block that takes it.
